title: IFRA joins EU-ASEAN Business Council mission to Vietnam
summary: IFRA joined a business mission to Vietnam organized by the EU-ASEAN Business Council, with meetings at the Ministry of Health and the Department of Customs.

extraction.key_fact: IFRA가 베트남 보건부와 세관을 만나는 사절단에 참여했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: IFRA joined a business mission to Vietnam organized by the EU-ASEAN Business Council, with meetings at the Ministry of Health and the Department of Customs.
